newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei ends below 20,000, hurt by Tokai news.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei ends below 20,000, hurt by Tokai news.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's benchmark Nikkei index ended below the 20,000 level on Friday, the first time it has done so since the end of May, depressed by news in the afternoon that construction firm Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd had decided to apply for court protection, brokers said. The Nikkei average finished 153.41 points or 0.76 percent lower at 19,968.00. It last closed below 20,000 on May 27 at 19,889.89. During the session, it fell as low as 19,907.39.
Nikkei 225 September futures ended 260 points down at 19,910.

"The Tokai news depressed stocks but the impact was somewhat limited as there had been rumours about the company in the past and the market had already factored most of it in," said Mikio Takada, Nikko Securities general manager.
